temporal_unit: One POSITION = one (token_index, selection) entry yielded, in order, by Trace.token_selections(layer, phase) for one layer; positions are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in that yielded order (never by raw token_index). A selection is an unordered SET of concurrently selected experts: no artificial within-token ordering is ever constructed.
